article.headline: Bukumirovic scores 21, UT Martin downs Eastern Illinois 76-68
article.description: — Andrija Bukumirovic scored 21 points as UT Martin beat Eastern Illinois 76-68 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Bukumirovic scores 21, UT Martin downs Eastern Illinois 76-68

categories.description: UT Martin Skyhawks @ Eastern Illinois Panthers

event.description: UT Martin Skyhawks @ Eastern Illinois Panthers

keywords: UT Martin Skyhawks @ Eastern Illinois Panthers
article.story: CHARLESTON, Ill. -- — Andrija Bukumirovic scored 21 points as UT Martin beat Eastern Illinois 76-68 on Thursday. Bukumirovic also contributed nine rebounds for the Skyhawks (16-5, 8-2 Ohio Valley Conference). Damien King scored 17 points, shooting 7 for 8, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Afan Trnka had 10 points and shot 3 for 5 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line. Terry McMorris finished with 15 points, eight rebounds, four assists and three steals for the Panthers (9-13, 5-6). Meechie White added 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
